title: Mac Folder Atlas
description: Is it safe to delete this folder on a Mac? One record per folder. Text fields are Markdown with absolute links. CC BY 4.0, credit “Mac Folder Atlas (siftmac.com)”.

updated.description: The latest date any answer changed.

verdicts.description: Each verdict key with the label the app and site show, and what it means.

id.description: Stable id, also the page's slug.

name.description: A short name for the folder or file.

paths.description: Where it is, written for people: ~ is the home folder, <project> any project folder, … any folders in between.

answer.description: The short answer: the summary's first sentence, or its first two when the first is only a few words.

summary.description: The answer, what it costs (or what to do instead), and whether it comes back.

comes_back.description: Does it come back, and how.

what.description: What it is: the page's first paragraph about it.

measure.description: Shell commands that show how big it is.

clear_commands.description: The shell commands in how_to_clear, as written there.

match.description: Globs for tools: ~ is the home folder, * part of one name, **/ any folders. A path matches when it is the folder or inside it; the deepest match wins.

beside.description: A file that must sit next to the folder for this rule to match.

has.description: A file that must be inside the folder for this rule to match.

verdict.description: This folder's own verdict, when the page treats it differently from the entry.

note.description: Why, in the page's words. Always given with verdict.

markdown_url.description: The full answer as Markdown, for AI tools.
